name: Moreno Fisher
strengths: Fisher's listed 6-7 frame is the trait — rare tackle length and tackle-box reach you don't coach onto a shorter OT.
Fisher already made the DE-to-RT conversion as a junior — Independence tape is labeled T/DE because he is playing tackle, not a projection still standing up from the edge.
Fisher is a basketball athlete at that height — change of direction and foot quickness you don't always get in 6-7 tackles still listed 270.
weaknesses: Fisher's 270 on a 6-7 frame still needs mass and play strength vs SEC edge power. Conversion-year pass set and independent hands vs speed-to-power are the growth items — don't oversell a finished punch from highlight T/DE reps.
comparison: Fisher comps to Walker Little — 6-7 tackle length who filled out later; long-frame OT, not a finished 320-pound mauler yet (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Fisher projects as Year 1 develop (add mass and clean up the pass set after the DE-to-OT conversion), Year 2 compete in the OT room, with starter-upside as a length tackle — not a rotational OT as the ceiling.
schemeFit: Fisher fits Trautwein's room as a length tackle who can grow into a zone/power hybrid once the mass arrives.
staffNotes: FILM VERIFIED 2026-11-12 from Independence (Charlotte) junior Hudl T/DE reel (8:18, embed 19658142/69361f27ea0d31db0393afac). Conversion-year tape after Fisher moved from DE to RT. Verified: 6-7 length, tackle alignment on the junior reel, basketball-athlete movement at that height. NOT a finished pass-set sample vs SEC speed-to-power — do not oversell punch or pancake counts from highlight cuts. Florida commit November 12, 2026 (On3 Chad Simmons / Corey Bender); former Virginia. Comp size-matched Walker Little; skipped Florida-alum default. Not provisional.
recruitingStory: Moreno Fisher committed to Florida on November 12, 2026. Fisher is a 2027 OT out of Hough (Cornelius, NC) — listed 6-7 / 270 — after an official Oklahoma visit November 6–8. Former Virginia pledge. Phil Trautwein is the OL pull.
angle: Florida 2027 OT commit. Tape sell is 6-7 length in a DE-to-tackle conversion year.
insiderNotes: Fisher is a 6-7 length tackle in a conversion year — junior Independence tape is T/DE after he moved from defensive end to right tackle. The frame is the trait. Mass and a finished pass set are still coming. Basketball athlete at that height, so the feet are better than a lot of 6-7 tackles you see at 270.
